`tax_oss_quarterly_export` RPC return shape doesn't match contract. CSV builder reads undefined fields → corrupted output. Fix by dropping + recreating with correct shape.

## File

`supabase/migrations/20260511100000_payments_l2_tax_oss_export_fix.sql`

## Contents

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- Migration : 20260511100000_payments_l2_tax_oss_export_fix.sql
-- Sprint    : 19 — Sage Critical fix (C1)
-- Owner     : Dato
-- Spec      : lib/payments/contracts.ts TaxOssQuarterlyExportResult
--
-- Purpose   : Replace tax_oss_quarterly_export RPC with contract-aligned shape.
--             Original from 20260510100000 returned amount_collected_cents +
--             amount_remitted_cents per jurisdiction + total_eu_tax_cents top-level.
--             Contract requires:
--               per-jurisdiction: amount_collected_cents, amount_remitted_cents,
--                                 amount_outstanding_cents, registration_status
--               top-level: studio_id, period, jurisdictions[],
--                          total_eu_collected_cents, total_eu_outstanding_cents
--
-- DOWN: restore the 20260510100000 version (caller pastes from prior migration).
-- =============================================================================

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS tax_oss_quarterly_export(uuid, int, int);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tax_oss_quarterly_export(
  p_studio_id uuid,
  p_year      int,
  p_quarter   int
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_period text;
  v_jurisdictions jsonb;
  v_total_collected bigint;
  v_total_outstanding bigint;
  v_eu_codes text[] := ARRAY[
    'AT','BE','BG','CY','CZ','DE','DK','EE','ES','FI','FR','GR','HR','HU',
    'IE','IT','LT','LU','LV','MT','NL','PL','PT','RO','SE','SI','SK'
  ];
BEGIN
  IF p_quarter < 1 OR p_quarter > 4 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_oss_quarterly_export: quarter must be 1-4, got %', p_quarter;
  END IF;

  v_period := p_year::text || '-Q' || p_quarter::text;

  -- Aggregate per jurisdiction with registration_status join.
  WITH ledger_rows AS (
    SELECT
      trl.jurisdiction,
      trl.amount_collected_cents,
      trl.amount_remitted_cents,
      (trl.amount_collected_cents - trl.amount_remitted_cents) AS amount_outstanding_cents
    FROM tax_remittance_ledger trl
    WHERE trl.studio_id = p_studio_id
      AND trl.period = v_period
      AND (
        trl.jurisdiction LIKE 'EU-%'
        OR substring(trl.jurisdiction, 1, 2) = ANY(v_eu_codes)
      )
  ),
  with_status AS (
    SELECT
      lr.jurisdiction,
      lr.amount_collected_cents,
      lr.amount_remitted_cents,
      lr.amount_outstanding_cents,
      reg.status AS registration_status
    FROM ledger_rows lr
    LEFT JOIN stripe_tax_registrations reg
      ON reg.studio_id = p_studio_id
      AND reg.jurisdiction = lr.jurisdiction
      AND reg.status = 'active'
  )
  SELECT
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'jurisdiction', ws.jurisdiction,
      'amount_collected_cents', ws.amount_collected_cents,
      'amount_remitted_cents', ws.amount_remitted_cents,
      'amount_outstanding_cents', ws.amount_outstanding_cents,
      'registration_status', ws.registration_status
    )), '[]'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(SUM(ws.amount_collected_cents), 0),
    COALESCE(SUM(ws.amount_outstanding_cents), 0)
  INTO v_jurisdictions, v_total_collected, v_total_outstanding
  FROM with_status ws;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'studio_id', p_studio_id,
    'period', v_period,
    'jurisdictions', v_jurisdictions,
    'total_eu_collected_cents', v_total_collected,
    'total_eu_outstanding_cents', v_total_outstanding
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION tax_oss_quarterly_export(uuid, int, int) IS
  'S19 Critical fix. Returns OSS quarterly aggregate per EU jurisdiction + totals. Contract: TaxOssQuarterlyExportResult.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION tax_oss_quarterly_export(uuid, int, int) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tax_oss_quarterly_export(uuid, int, int) TO service_role;
```

After writing, report:
- Filename + line count.
- Confirm 3 fields per jurisdiction (collected + remitted + outstanding + registration_status).
- Confirm 2 top-level totals (collected + outstanding).

EXECUTE NOW. WRITE THE FILE. NO PLAN OUTPUT.
